title: Tenma Tsukasa — Training With A Buddy!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Kamiyama High School

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? That looks like...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Akito!! Good morning!!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Whoa! Only one person shouts like that...
se_walk_men_002_1

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Why'd you shout at me from all the way down the corridor...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? I decided to greet you after we'd made eye contact, is all.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: People don't normally greet each other from that far away!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hah hah hah! The training we did has given me the power to project my voice even further!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now I can greet others even if they're a good distance away! A useful skill for a hall monitor, wouldn't you say?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait, is it really okay for a hall monitor to be shouting in the corridor like this?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Anyway, if you don't need anything else from me, I'll be going to my classroom now.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
No, wait.
I do have some fun news to tell you!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The thing is, Rui made it so that a few friends and I could try water spiders for ourselves!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: The area beyond this buoy is very deep, so it's off limits, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Emu, Len, Rin & Miku
rows.Line:
Okay!
Okay♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I still can't believe you actually made these. What are these? Inner tubes? And these look like sandals attached to plywood...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I glued those together, and I secured the boards to the center of each inner tube.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's a simple design, but these are fairly close to what was used for traditional ninja water spiders.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, these do look very similar to the ones Akito had to use.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Tsukasa, you guys!
Let's go on the water already!

rows.Speaker: Rin, Miku & Len
rows.Line: <Yeah!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You guys already put them on?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
All of you, wait!
We need to stretch before going in the water!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Nooo! H-How do I stop my legs from spreading apart?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Flex your inner thigh muscles!
Then, use the pole to support yourself, while lowering your center of gravity.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: There's no way I can...! Eep!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, Nene flipped over.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Sounds like a job for the lifeguard!
I'll be right there to help, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
This is so cool☆
I'm getting a little support, but I can stand now♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Your inner tubes must be providing just enough buoyancy.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
You also got it to work, Rin?!
Tsukasa helped me get me floating!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hehe. Then, let's have a race♪
The first one to get to the buoy wins!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Alright, you're on!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Then, we'll let go after we give you the signal to start. Are you both ready?

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: Ready!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Here we go.
Ready... Start!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Let's go!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Forward!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wow, they're both off to a good start!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: This should be a fine race.

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: Uh oh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Th-They fell in...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Rin! Len! Are you okay?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hmm...
They just barely managed to stand, so it makes sense moving forward would be difficult.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Look! Those two are standing all on their own...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wow! And I think they're trying to have a race just like us!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! It looks like Miku and Emu are gonna...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Can they reach it...?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Let's go, Miku!
Nin-Nin-Ninja!

rows.Speaker: Emu & Miku
rows.Line: Gooooooo!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Poweeeeeer!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Speeeeeeed!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Whoa, look how fast they're moving their feet!
Could they possibly...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
No, they're not moving forward...
If anything, they appear to be sinking.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Glub... Glub...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hey, Emu! Are you okay?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Miku sank too!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Don't worry, someone will be right over to rescue you two. And by someone I mean MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Leave it to me!
Let's go, lifeguard♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Anyway, my friends and I tried to do what you did, but it ended up being a perilous task.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Just standing was hard enough.
To think that you were able to reach the other side, even after one of your foot straps broke.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: After experiencing it for myself, I now have a much greater appreciation for what you accomplished! I tip my hat to you!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Thank you? You showered me with praise after the race.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I mean, I think I was only able to do that because of Kiritani's training plan.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I too feel that I was able to survive my stage for the same reason!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Her plans would've made even pro athletes shudder. They really were something else.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: She'd be more than welcome to become the trainer for Wonderlands×Showtime!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait, what kind of shows are you planning to put on over there, anyway?
